items.title: Harry "Sweets" Edison interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: when I first joined the band, everybody in the Count Basie band had played with Bennie Moten’s band.

ctx.x: That was my question. Now how did that work? And how did you learn what to play when you first got in there?

Well, that’s an interesting question. Because when I first joined the band, everybody in the Count Basie band had played with Bennie Moten’s band. So they all knew what they wanted to play. They all had notes to different — like “One O’Clock Jump,” “Swinging the Blues,” “Out the Window.” It was a head arrangement you know.
